name: PIE
recent: PIE Industrial 在2026年11月12日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净利回升至 RM11.53 million，主要因工厂使用率提高和成本控制改善。同期，大股东 Pan-International Industrial Corporation 和 Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd 在10月和11月均有股权变动申报。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日的季度净利回升至 RM11.53 million。
大股东 Pan-International Industrial Corporation 和 Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd 在2026年10月及11月申报股权变动。
earnings: 最新季度（2026年6月30日）营收为 RM180.13 million，环比增长26.4%，但同比下跌22.0%；净利为 RM3.81 million，同比下跌40.2%，净利率为2.1%，较上一季度的-4.0%有所改善。

recent_en: PIE Industrial reported its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 12 November 2026, with net profit recovering to RM11.53 million, mainly due to higher factory utilisation and improved cost controls. Meanwhile, substantial shareholders Pan-International Industrial Corporation and Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd filed changes in their shareholdings in October and November.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 recovered to RM11.53 million.
Substantial shareholders Pan-International Industrial Corporation and Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd reported changes in their shareholdings in October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue was RM180.13 million, up 26.4% QoQ but down 22.0% YoY; net profit was RM3.81 million, down 40.2% YoY, with a net margin of 2.1%, improved from -4.0% in the previous quarter.
